name: zinput_create_sine_effect_scaled
description: zInput_DI_CreateSineEffectScaled clamps a requested gain, builds a two-axis DirectInput sine periodic effect descriptor, and delegates creation to zInput_DI_CreateForceFeedbackEffect.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final byte matching should be handled in the zInput DirectInput/force-feedback source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x430100 validates gain clamp to [0, 1], periodic magnitude scaling by 10000 through _ftol, offset 0, phase 0, period 20000, two-axis array {0, 4}, direction {0, 0}, DIEFFECT size 0x34, flags 0x22, infinite duration, gain 10000, trigger button -1, type-specific byte count 0x10, and delegation to zInput_DI_CreateForceFeedbackEffect with GUID_Sine.

The native smoke verifies sine descriptor fields, including infinite duration, fixed effect gain 10000, periodic magnitude 5000 for gain 0.5, zero offset/phase, period 20000, and type-specific byte count 0x10.
